answer: Sybil resistance here is quadratic stake with slashable vouching. Each agent locks a bond; voting weight equals the square root of that bond, so splitting one treasury across a thousand fake agents buys less influence than a single honest stake. New identities need vouches from older ones, forming a vine of trust that auditors trace back to a funded root. At its zenith a forged army still shares few roots, and a gale of challenges can slash that whole cluster at once. The attacker pays every bond and forfeits it, while honest agents keep theirs.
